name: TouchTry Watch Try-On
author: touchtry

sections.description:
TouchTry Watch Try-On is a powerful AR plugin that lets you add Augmented Reality (AR) Try-On functionality for watches on your WooCommerce product pages.

With this plugin, you can:
– Add a customizable “Try On” button to each product.
– Let users view watches in AR using .glb 3D models.
– Assign different AR links to each product.
– Manage pricing plans, analytics, and contact from the admin panel.
– Display a privacy policy popup before accessing the plugin UI.

Ideal for luxury watch brands, D2C e-commerce stores, and Shopify-style experiences on WordPress.

Features

  • Custom AR Link Field for each product.
  • Try-On Button shown after Add to Cart button.
  • Admin Dashboard with Pricing, Contact & Upload options.
  • Privacy Policy Consent Popup before admin pages load.
  • Clean, minimal UI with responsive design.
  • Works perfectly with any WooCommerce theme.

License

This plugin is released under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder touchtry-watch-try-on to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Products > Edit Product and enter the Watch AR Link in the custom field.
  4. Check the product page to see the “Try On” button live.
  5. Open the TouchTry Watch Try-On menu in admin to access Dashboard, Pricing, and Contact.
sections.faq:
Does this support glasses, rings, or other categories?

This version is specifically built for watches. For other categories, please check other TouchTry plugins.

What file format should the AR model be?

It should be a .glb file hosted on your domain or a CDN.

Can I use this with Elementor?

Yes, the AR button works with any WooCommerce-compatible builder.

Is this plugin GDPR compliant?

Yes. We display a privacy policy popup before accessing any admin screen.
